verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows a generic /pricing page reference (workflow automation) with no per-tool-call or per-connection pricing figures, and no documented rate limits anywhere in the docs or probes. Community reports (glama-comm-2, glama-comm-3) actually describe an undocumented billing requirement (a credit card needed for rebuilds) that surprised users, further indicating the platform lacks the transparent, documented pricing/rate-limit information the story asks for.
